family_reports.body: The lies that were told and upheld in family court allowed my dad to win because he had all the money, and it cost us as teenagers to be forced to go live with him again after he was abusive to us through our childhood.

Family court was a nightmare that felt as though it would never end. It nearly killed me. It tore our family apart and left my daughters (both) destroyed with PTSD on top of the abuse their father did to them- then family court punished them even further.
